description: Request a page as Googlebot, Bingbot and the AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, ClaudeBot) and see who gets a 403, a 429 or a firewall challenge that robots.txt does not show. Also returns the date of the newest sitemap lastmod and whether Cloudflare is in front. Free, without an account. The same page within one hour returns the stored result. The page is requested with the published user agent of Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and once as a browser. A 403, a 429 or a firewall challenge that only a crawler gets is the block that robots.txt does not show. The sitemap is the one that robots.txt declares, or `/sitemap.xml`; it is stale when its newest `lastmod` is more than 30 days old. Limit: Cloudflare recognises the real crawler by its IP address, so a rule that trusts verified bots can treat the real crawler differently. The same page within one hour returns the stored result (`cached_at`) without requesting the site again.
name: check_ai_access
title: Check ai access
